comment: x-ms-user-quota-remaining is '0' and x-ms-user-quota-resets-after is PRESENT but not parseable as a duration -- 'unknown', not a d.hh:mm:ss value (Req 20.14). Must be treated identically to the header being absent entirely: a 5-second fallback wait, at most 3 consecutive times before a 4th required wait reports THROTTLED. A collector that only checks presence rather than parseability would wrongly treat this as a normal reset-header wait rather than the fallback path.
